newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodia's Hun Sen says Ranariddh breaking law.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia's Hun Sen says Ranariddh breaking law.

text.p: Cambodia's Second Prime Minister Hun Sen on Saturday accused his rival, First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh, of breaking the law by trying to smuggle Khmer Rouge defectors into Phnom Penh.
Hun Sen said in a radio broadcast that Ranariddh was negotiating with the Khmer Rouge guerrilla group illegally and he was also bringing Khmer Rouge troops into the capital illegally.
"I do not allow anyone in any position to destroy the country's future," Hun Sen said.
The second prime minister said action taken against what he described as illegal troops was a matter of law and order and did not constitute a civil war.
"I would like to declare publicly that this is the activity of law implementation by the armed forces of the government against law violators and illegal forces and this is not a civil war," he said.
Troops loyal to the rival prime ministers clashed on the northwestern outskirts of Phnom Penh earlier on Saturday as soldiers loyal to Hun Sen approached a base controlled by Ranariddh's men.
